findings.claim: The plan schedules a from-scratch upstream sync and parity change while ignoring an existing, largely complete 2026-10-16 sync and SurrealDB parity in local branches and worktrees, so C-001/C-002 will redo or contradict work already done.
findings.evidence: Branches chore/upstream-merge-2026-10-16 (3bcb9a32e 'chore(merge): upstream 2026-10-16 (87 commits) + BossFang preservation', be7518a85 merge report docs/upstream-merges/2026-10-16.md resolving the same 28 conflicts, including migration.rs fork v62 -> v64) and chore/upstream-merge-2026-10-16-schema (e2f5382a2 migrations 050-054, 107f38cd3 Surreal manifest-version and ephemeral-run stores) exist, with worktrees under /private/tmp/librefang-upstream-2026-10-16*; none is on origin/main (3bcb9a32e not an ancestor). No phase-12 artifact mentions them (grep '2026-10-16' over the phase dir is empty). C-001 task 1.1 says to merge 'all 103+ commits' fresh in /tmp/librefang-sync-2026-10.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a decision and task to C-001: rebase or re-merge from the 2026-10-16 branches (fetch the 16 newer upstream commits on top), or record an explicit rationale for discarding them. Fold the schema branch into C-002 instead of rebuilding it.

findings.claim: C-002 undercounts the SurrealDB parity the sync needs, and its 'no unrelated schema changes' boundary forbids the extra work, so the merged default backend would be left out of parity.
findings.evidence: C-002 scopes only '050_task_queue_timeout_secs' and '051_ephemeral_runs_truncated' plus the manifest store. The prior parity work for an 87-commit subset of the same upstream range (e2f5382a2) found five migrations were needed: 051 task_queue claim columns (title, description, created_by, result, claimed_at, retry_count plus an index the claim-TTL sweep needs), 053 workflow_runs.state 'cancelled' (fork SQLite v64), and 054 workflow_runs.owner_agent_id / usage_events.billed_agent_id (upstream v49 #7714). It also found that a Surreal ephemeral-run store and a SurrealTaskBackend::task_reset_stuck rewrite (#7974) were needed (107f38cd3). C-002 proposal Boundary: 'No unrelated schema changes'.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-derive the parity list from the full post-merge SQLite diff (every CREATE/ALTER plus behavioral store changes), include the ephemeral-run store, the claim-TTL sweep and the importer (sqlite_to_surreal), and drop the hard-coded 050/051 numbering.

findings.claim: C-000, C-003 and C-004 have no PR, fresh-context review or merge-ancestry tasks, yet C-001 requires C-000 to be on main, and CLAUDE.md requires an independent review before anything merges.
findings.evidence: C-001 task 1.1: 'From a linked worktree on the post-C-000 `main`'. C-000 tasks end at 2.2 (clippy). C-003 ends at 4.1 and C-004 at 3.1. Only C-001 has review (3.1) and PR/ancestry (3.2) tasks. plan.md line 11 claims 'every PR in this phase confirms the final head SHA is an ancestor of origin/main'. CLAUDE.md: 'Nothing merges to main without a review in a fresh context'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add review, PR (--repo GQAdonis/librefang), operator-merge and ancestry-check tasks, each with a model-assignment row, to C-000, C-003 and C-004. Make C-001 1.1 explicitly wait on C-000's merge.

findings.claim: The real-service test lesson is claimed but not enforced: C-002 allows remote variants to SKIP, which contradicts its own spec scenario.
findings.evidence: plan.md line 12: 'C-002 runs remote SurrealDB variants against a real local 3.3.0 server'. C-002 task 3.1: 'env-gated remote variants ... explicit SKIP line when unset'. The spec scenario requires the value to round-trip 'in embedded and remote mode'.
findings.suggested_fix: Make completion of 3.1 require a recorded non-SKIP remote run (ws and http) against SurrealDB 3.3.0, with the log as evidence.

findings.claim: The SQLite migration renumbering, the correctness-critical part of C-001, has no task to write tests, and its spec scenario covers only one of the lineages the requirement names.
findings.evidence: C-001 spec requirement: 'exactly once on both fresh databases and databases already stamped by either lineage'. Only one scenario exists ('database stamped by BossFang v62'), with none for fresh databases or upstream-stamped v62/v63. Task 2.2 just runs the existing `cargo test -p librefang-memory`, and task 1.2 says nothing about adding tests.
findings.suggested_fix: Add scenarios and a task for migration tests covering fresh, fork-stamped 62 and upstream-stamped 62/63 databases, plus idempotent reopen.

findings.claim: C-002 adds dual-path backend selection, but its verification omits the workspace check, workspace clippy and branding audit, which run in C-001 2.2 before C-002's code exists.
findings.evidence: C-002 task 3.1 runs only `cargo test -p librefang-storage` and `-p librefang-memory`. The constraints.md 'Verification gates (blocking)' require `cargo check --workspace --lib`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `enforce-branding.py --check` for every behavioral change. 'Select it whenever the Surreal backend is active' (task 2.1) likely touches the kernel or API wiring.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a final combined-branch verification task after C-002 (workspace check, clippy, scoped tests for every touched crate, branding) before C-001 3.1 review.

findings.claim: C-001 verification omits `cargo test -p librefang-api` and `-p librefang-kernel`, although the merge resolves conflicts in API routes and kernel messaging.
findings.evidence: Conflicts include routes/task_queue.rs, routes/config/manage.rs, channel_bridge.rs and kernel/messaging.rs (assessment lines 43-44). C-001 task 2.2 tests only librefang-memory, librefang-llm-drivers and librefang-acp. CLAUDE.md requires TestServer integration tests in `crates/librefang-api/tests/` for route and wiring changes.
findings.suggested_fix: Add scoped `cargo test -p librefang-api`, `-p librefang-kernel` and `-p librefang-channels` to 2.2. Also check the uar-driver chain, for example `cargo check -p librefang-cli --features uar-driver`.

findings.claim: Several model-assignment rows name one model but route to an agent instance launched on a different model, so routing is ambiguous.
findings.evidence: Row C-001 2.1: 'Anthropic claude-sonnet' / 'upstream-merge-manager agent (model=sonnet acceptable; same agent inherits opus)'. Row C-001 2.3 says sonnet but uses the 'upstream-merge-manager agent' launched as model=opus in 1.1. Row C-004 3.1 says sonnet with 'same agent' (product-manager launched model=opus in 1.1).
findings.suggested_fix: Either set these rows to opus (same instance) or specify a separate model=sonnet launch with an explicit handoff.

findings.claim: C-003 edits `crates/librefang-cli/Cargo.toml`, which a blocking constraint forbids without explicit user instruction, and the plan records no such instruction.
findings.evidence: constraints.md, Implementation rules (blocking): 'Do not modify `librefang-cli` without explicit user instruction.' C-003 task 2.1: 'Correct the `uar-driver` comments in `crates/librefang-cli/Cargo.toml`'. Decisions D-001 to D-003 contain no authorization.
findings.suggested_fix: Obtain and record operator approval at dispatch, or update constraints.md if upstream #8605 lifting the freeze is adopted.

findings.claim: C-004's acceptance scenario is conditioned on the child-phase plan, which is written after C-004 completes, so C-004 cannot be verified on its own terms.
findings.evidence: Scenario: 'WHEN the child phase plan is written THEN each of A01–A20 maps to at least one change and one named test suite'. plan.md line 44: 'Then: `/kbd-new-child` (via C-004) → child-phase assess and plan for G3'. C-004 task 2.3 maps rows only to 'proposed changes'.
findings.suggested_fix: Restate the scenario against C-004's own output, for example the baseline document's A01–A20 mapping table.

findings.claim: The child-phase goals omit two inputs the assessment required: the explicit exclusion of #162–#167 (M1–M5) and the reading of backlog.md.
findings.evidence: assessment.md round-1 corrections: 'The M1–M5 milestones are outside the #156 v1 profile, and planning should exclude them explicitly' and '`docs/bossfang/knowme-dot/backlog.md` ... is a required input for plan'. C-004 task 1.1 and its proposal mention neither.
findings.suggested_fix: Add both to C-004 task 1.1's goal amendment.

findings.claim: The memory-crate Surreal dual-path conflicts are assigned to upstream-merge-manager with no handoff to surrealdb-schema-engineer, which CLAUDE.md names as owner of the Surreal backends in librefang-memory.
findings.evidence: plan.md risks: 'the memory-crate dual-path conflicts are the hard parts'. C-001 tasks 1.1 and 1.2 sit with upstream-merge-manager. The CLAUDE.md routing table gives 'the Surreal backends in librefang-memory' to surrealdb-schema-engineer.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a handoff (or review) by surrealdb-schema-engineer for the proactive.rs, semantic.rs and substrate.rs resolutions.

findings.claim: The prerequisites column contradicts the stated dependency: C-003 2.1 lists 'none', but the ordering rationale says C-003 waits for the sync because it edits Cargo.toml comments the merge touches.
findings.evidence: plan.md line 20: 'C-003 edits `Cargo.toml` comments the merge touches'. Row C-003 2.1 Prerequisites: 'none'.
